verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no mention of an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The 'Formant agent' is on-device telemetry software, not an AI agent, and the SDKs, APIs, webhooks, in-app AI assistant and llms.txt probe are developer building blocks or adjacent features that earn no credit here.
